description: The Rep badge ladder: the Rep a wallet needs to claim tiers 1, 2, 3 and 4, read live from the RepBadge contract (rep is in whole Rep; repRaw is the contract value, 100 per Rep). A tier badge is claimed once a wallet's Rep reaches its threshold. For one wallet's own Rep and next level use next_moves; for the Velvet rooms use get_velvet. Read only.
name: rep_tiers
